recap: Cavaliers beat the Celtics 114–113 in overtime.
Darius Garland led the Cavaliers with 29 points (9-20 FG, 5-11 3PT), 5 rebounds and 12 assists.
Jaylen Brown led the Celtics with 30 points (10-26 FG, 3-10 3PT), 8 rebounds and 4 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security. Effective FG% 47.5 to 46.8.
Biggest swing: Jaylen Brown personal foul (Q4 14.3), +22 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Mitchell, Wade, Garland, Mobley, +8 in 5:39.
Bench points: CLE 16, BOS 26. Points in the paint: 56–40. Second-chance points: 8–8.
